verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations, such as mass refunds, batch payouts or bulk charge management, are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a bulk or batch capability. The payouts page (kushki-docs-18) only describes paying suppliers, partners and employees, with no batch mechanism. The recurring and scheduled charge docs (kushki-docs-29, kushki-docs-30) cover per-subscription schedules, not one operation applied across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
